title: RAG over Thinking Traces Can Improve Reasoning Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2605.03344v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) has proven effective for knowledge-intensive tasks, but is widely believed to offer limited benefit for reasoning-intensive problems such as math and code generation. We challenge this assumption by showing that the limitation lies not in RAG itself, but in the choice of corpus. Instead of retrieving documents, we propose retrieving thinking traces, i.e., intermediate thinking trajectories generated during problem solving attempts. We show that thinking traces are already a strong retrieval source, and further introduce T3, an offline method that transforms them into structured, retrieval-friendly representations, to improve usability. translated_title: 基于思维轨迹的检索增强生成能够提升推理任务表现
translated_abstract: 检索增强生成（RAG）已被证明对知识密集型任务有效，但人们普遍认为它对数学和代码生成等推理密集型问题的益处有限。我们挑战了这一假设，指出其局限性不在于RAG本身，而在于语料库的选择。我们没有采用检索文档的方式，而是提出检索“思维轨迹”，即问题求解尝试过程中产生的中间思考轨迹。我们证明思维轨迹本身已经是一种强大的检索来源，并进一步引入T3——一种离线方法，可将这些轨迹转换为结构化、检索友好的表示形式，以提升其可用性。以这些轨迹作为语料库，一个简单的“先检索后生成”流程在多种强大模型和基准测试（如AIME 2025–2026、LiveCodeBench和GPQA-Diamond）上持续提升推理性能，超越了非RAG基线和检索基线。
tldr: 该论文提出用“思维轨迹”替代传统文档作为RAG的检索语料库，并引入T3离线方法将其转化为结构化的检索友好表示，从而在数学、代码生成等推理任务上显著且稳定地超越非RAG和检索基线。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes retrieving thinking traces rather than documents as the RAG corpus, and introduces T3, an offline method that converts them into structured, retrieval-friendly representations, consistently outperforming non-RAG and retrieval baselines on reasoning benchmarks such as AIME 2025–2026, LiveCodeBench, and GPQA-Diamond.
